title: A Horthy-korszak társadalma (Gentry, Coffeehouses & Rural Realities)
grammar: Institutional Participles (-andó/-endő), Instrumentality Connectors & Historical Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can understand and discuss Gentry, Coffeehouses & Rural Realities in interwar Hungarian history.
I can name the social groups of interwar Hungary and the forms of address used.
I can explain what dzsentri and úri középosztály meant.
I can use six words about interwar society, such as dzsentri and nagybirtokrendszer.
